events.title: We're in Next Fest!
events.summary: We are in Steam Next Fest! This is quite crazy for us. I mean, just a year ago, we were nowhere near such an important milestone. We did not even have a public Steam page back then. Now we have a cool demo and are making a lot of progress towards the release of the game. Speaking of demo, I hope you will consider trying ours. events.title: We are in the Out-of-the-Box showcase!
events.summary: We are extremely honored to announce that we have been selected to appear in the Out-of-the-Box showcase! This showcase runs from September 21 to 28 and it features an amazing array of games. Check out the showcase page at https://store.steampowered.com/curator/46192764/sale/OUTOFTHEBOXGAMESCheck out and wishlist some amazing games including AGENCY!As part of the festival, we are also announcing a Steam Deck compatibility for AGENCY. events.title: Supporting the Steam Deck with a native Linux build!
events.summary: We are happy to announce that AGENCY is going to have Steam Deck support at launch using a native Linux build! The demo is already playable on the deck. We tested it on an LCD model and we expect the game to look gorgeous on the OLED model. We also recommend using headphones instead of the built-in speakers to really enjoy the audio.Since this is a native Linux build, we are making the build available for desktop Linux users too.
